$room..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('owner').val() === auth.uid) || (data.child('owner').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('owner').val() === auth.uid))

state..validate: newData.hasChildren(['version', 'title', 'size', 'teams', 'totalRaces', 'revision']) && newData.child('version').val() === 1 && newData.child('title').isString() && newData.child('title').val().length <= 100 && (newData.child('size').val() === 2 || newData.child('size').val() === 3 || newData.child('size').val() === 4) && newData.child('revision').isNumber()
